pages.text: You are male or female, like everyone else - your journal says which.$(br2)Groom or feed somebody of the other sex and you are courting them: three times, or once with their favourite food. Or, at bond two, pick them out and ask: $(l)Be my mate$().

Before habilis nobody is anybody's in particular. From habilis on it is one mate, kept - and yours stays close. When a predator strikes you, your mate is on it faster and harder; when one strikes your mate, so are you.
Pick your mate out and ask $(l)Let's have a child$(). If you are female you carry it; if not, they do. A pregnancy takes a day and eats: hunger runs fast, and food is what they ask for.

Near the end the mother goes off alone to give birth, and glows - and everything that hunts can find her too. While a birth is being guarded, your band fights harder and your display drives off anything at all.
